none: PAS NLM-EB5601: Roman Coin: Barbarous Radiate
contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Probably a barbarous radiate, issue of 275-285, Reece period 14. Two small chips lost from flan ?at time of striking. Obverse description: Radiate bust right. Reverse description: two lines enclosing large feature. Reverse inscription: VOLICAE, presumably blundered. Diameter: 13.2mm, Weight: 1.41gms, die axis: possibly 12
